heuristic.rule: Flag if payment_mode == COD and product_category in ['footwear', 'apparel']

logistic_regression.model: LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000) on StandardScaler-ed one-hot features, same train/test split as LightGBM

threshold_selection.method: Cost-optimal threshold is selected by sweeping thresholds against the VALIDATION set only, then frozen and applied to the test set below. The test set never influences threshold selection.

test_metrics.note: Threshold was frozen from validation-set selection above; these are its results on held-out test data it never influenced.

failure_case.explanation: This footwear order (Rs.2,758, COD) was predicted high-risk (probability 99.0%) but was NOT returned. Likely cause: the risk signals (category, payment mode, customer history) aligned toward high risk, but this particular buyer was satisfied with the product despite the statistical profile suggesting otherwise.
